tips_en: Read Paper 1 (WICL/RoboScript) first: it presents a broad, well-supported approach to robust manipulation without gradient updates, combining editable semantic memory, simulator feedback, and reflection with evidence across 50 tasks and cross-embodiment real-robot tests. Paper 3 is a close methodological companion—both use frozen predictive models to improve control, but Paper 1 externalizes task knowledge into semantic memory while Paper 3 grounds foresight in 3D hand motion and visual change. Paper 2 is complementary, benchmarking long-context reasoning, multi-option selection, and calibration in text-based System-1 decision models.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文 1（WICL/RoboScript）：它以可编辑的语义记忆、仿真反馈和反思机制，展示了无需梯度更新的鲁棒操作能力，并在 50 个任务及跨本体真实机器人测试中提供了充分证据。论文 3 与它方法上最为接近：两者都使用冻结的预测模型改进控制，但论文 1 将任务知识外化为语义记忆，论文 3 则以三维手部运动和视觉变化为基础学习空间预见。论文 2 则从长上下文推理、多选项选择和概率校准角度，为文本 System-1 决策模型提供互补评测。
